task: Supervised fMRI-to-memorability decoding, distinct from raw-pattern RSA
protocol: 1,000 train videos (3 repeats averaged); 102 test videos (10 repeats averaged); fit separately for 10 participants and 3 predeclared ROIs
selection: StandardScaler on training-video means, RidgeCV LOO MSE over 17 alphas from 0.01 to 1e6; no test labels in scaling, training, or hyperparameter selection
uncertainty: 2,000 test-video bootstrap draws shared across participants; conditional on these participants and fitted models
limitations: fMRI features require observing the brain response; this is not a video-only memorability predictor.
Averaging 10 test repeats gives more precise test features than averaging 3 train repeats.
All ROI results are reported; no model/ROI is selected using test performance.
The original low raw-pattern RSA effects remain valid and are not replaced by this different supervised task.
